marker.description: A small dark pin head is visible on the anterior surface of the pubic bone.

main_question: Identify the bone indicated by the pin.
main_explanation: The pin is located on the anterior portion of the pelvic ring, specifically the body of the pubis, which forms the anterior part of the obturator foramen.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures articulates with the bone indicated by the pin to form the pubic symphysis?
supporting_question.explanation: The pubic symphysis is a cartilaginous joint that connects the right and left pubic bones at the midline of the anterior pelvis.
